map.JWT（JSON Web Token）形如: A JWT (JSON Web Token) looks like
map.，前两段是 Base64URL 编码的 JSON，第三段是签名。用 . 分割即可: , the first two segments are Base64URL-encoded JSON and the third is the signature. Split on . to decode and inspect each part.
map.签发时间。exp 过期后 token 应被拒绝。: Issued-at time. After exp passes, the token should be rejected.
map.仅解码不验证签名；要验证签名必须持有对应密钥/公钥，且应在服务端完成。前端调试只: It only decodes without verifying the signature; verifying a signature requires holding the corresponding key or public key and should be done on the server side. Front-end debugging only does readable decoding.
map.JWT 中不要放密码等敏感信息（它只是编码不是加密），且切勿把生产密钥粘贴到不可: Never put passwords or other sensitive information in a JWT (it is encoded, not encrypted), and never paste production keys into untrusted pages.
map.Base64URL 和普通 Base64 一样吗？: Is Base64URL the same as ordinary Base64?
map.类似但把 + / 换成 - _ 并去掉填充 =，更适合放在 URL 中。: Similar, but with + and / replaced by - and _ and the = padding removed, making it more suitable for URLs.
map.为什么解码出 exp 但页面说已过期？: Why does exp decode but the page say it has expired?
map.exp 是 Unix 秒，需对照当前时间；可用时间戳工具核对。: exp is Unix seconds, so compare it with the current time; you can check it with a timestamp tool.
map.能在浏览器里验证签名吗？: Can the signature be verified in the browser?
map.可以持密钥验证，但密钥暴露在前端有风险；生产验证务必放服务端。: You can verify with the key, but exposing the key in the front end is risky; production verification must be done on the server side.
